description: This file serves as an index module for the 'workbox-streams' package, re-exporting functions and types related to stream management in a web application, including 'concatenate', 'concatenateToResponse', 'isSupported', and 'strategy'.

methods.name: concatenate
methods.description: A function to concatenate streams or responses.

methods.name: concatenateToResponse
methods.description: A function to convert concatenated streams into a Response object.

methods.name: isSupported
methods.description: Checks if the current environment supports the required streaming functionalities.

methods.name: strategy
methods.description: An export representing the streaming strategy used in the workbox streams.
